mapper.select: SELECT ASSET_ID, NAME, STATUS, CATEGORY, COMPANY, OWNER, MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, USAGE_TIME, LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE, EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, IMAGE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT, IS_DELETED FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N' AND ASSET_ID = #{assetId}

SELECT PART_ID, ASSET_ID, NAME, STATUS, LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE, EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, USAGE_TIME, MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, IS_DELETED FROM PART WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N' AND ASSET_ID = #{assetId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSET (NAME, STATUS, CATEGORY, COMPANY, MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, USAGE_TIME, LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE, EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, IMAGE, UPDATED_AT, OWNER) VALUES (#{modelName}, #{assetStatus}, #{category}, #{company}, #{maintenanceCycle, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{usageTime, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lastMaintenanceDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{expectedMaintenanceDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{imagePath}, #{updatedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{owner})

INSERT ALL
INTO PART ( ASSET_ID, NAME, STATUS, MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, CREATED_AT, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( #{p.assetId}, #{p.partName}, #{p.partStatus}, #{p.maintenanceCycle, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{p.expectedMaintenanceDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE ASSET SET IS_DELETED = 'Y', STATUS = 'AVAILABLE', DELETED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId}
UPDATE PART SET IS_DELETED = 'Y', STATUS = 'AVAILABLE', DELETED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PART_ID = #{partId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CATEGORY FROM ASSET WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(CATEGORY), '') IS NOT NULL AND IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY CATEGORY
SELECT DISTINCT COMPANY FROM ASSET WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(COMPANY), '') IS NOT NULL AND IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY COMPANY

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(( SELECT r.address_city FROM reservation r WHERE r.asset_id = a.asset_id AND r.status = 'APPROVED' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ), '농촌진흥청') AS location FROM asset a WHERE a.is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY location
